subject: ARPA Allocations and Municipal Paid Family Leave
overview: The committee reviewed the current allocation of ARPA funds and community survey results before discussing the financial and administrative impacts of opting municipal employees into the state's Paid Family and Medical Leave program.

items.title: ARPA Allocation and Community Survey Update
items.summary: Federal Funds Manager Lorena Escalero reported that $19.7 million in ARPA funds remain unallocated and presented survey data prioritizing water infrastructure, green spaces, and social services. The update was received and placed on file following council discussion on balancing infrastructure costs with affordable housing needs.

items.title: Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) Opt-In
items.summary: Finance Director Bob Dickinson presented cost projections for opting city employees into the state leave program, estimating annual city costs between $315,000 and $637,000. The committee kept the matter in committee and requested further research on administrative staffing requirements and a formal survey of employee interest.
